title: A Survey of Small Bodies in the Outer Solar System
text: Abstract. We present a preprint paper on asteroid, comet, orbit, diameter, albedo and planetary science measurements. Methods, results, references and citation metadata are included.

title: Exoplanet Atmosphere Retrieval with Telescope Spectroscopy
text: Abstract. This paper describes spectroscopy, exoplanet atmosphere, telescope data, methods, results, doi references and reproducible datasets.
